annotations.title: Check a trip with a gun

description: Check a drive or flight between two US states with a firearm: every state on the route, what each one says about what you are bringing (clear, caution or stop), what to do before you cross, and safer routes when one exists. The same check as the GunPartPicker gun travel checker. Items: pistol (Carry pistol (EDC)), longgun (AR-15 or other semi-auto rifle), mags (Magazines over 10 rounds), suppressor (Suppressor), sbr (SBR), brace (Braced AR pistol), frt (Forced reset trigger), binary (Binary trigger), hollowpoint (Hollow point ammo).

from.description: State the trip starts in: name or two letter code

magazine_size.description: Largest magazine coming along, in rounds

mode.description: auto drives when there is a land route

route.description: The states the highway crosses, in order, as two letter codes, when the road is known

name: check_gun_travel
